# BillCrafter

> Free online invoice generator for freelancers and small businesses. Create invoices, estimates, quotes and receipts in the browser, then download a clean, pixel-accurate PDF. No signup required to download your first PDF. Operated by CCC STUDIO (United States).

## What it does

- Invoice generator, estimate & quote generator, and receipt maker in one editor.
- 45 free, editable templates across 8 layouts and 9 industry categories.
- WYSIWYG editing: type directly on the document; totals and tax calculate live.
- Multi-currency and region-aware tax formatting; 25+ currencies incl. USD, EUR, GBP, INR, USDT/USDC.
- Free tier: 1 export without an account, 5 exports/month with a free account.
- Every document downloads as PDF — one format, pixel-accurate, no watermark on any plan.
- Pro (in private beta): unlimited exports, PAID/UNPAID status stamps, share links, recurring invoices.

## Built for how trades and services actually bill

These are the parts that differ from a generic invoice form, and the reason
someone in a trade would pick this over a blank template:

- **Job site address** — separate from the billing address, because trades bill the work location.
- **Sections with their own subtotals** — group lines under Labor and Materials, or under rate bands like "Senior consultant — $185/hr". Each heading totals itself.
- **Deposit due** — request a percentage or fixed amount up front. It prints on the document without changing the total.
- **Payment schedule** — a milestone table on the invoice: deposit, progress payments, final, each with a date and amount.
- **Job photos** — up to six captioned before/after photos at the foot of the invoice, exported inside the PDF. Used as proof of work by contractors, cleaners and pressure washing businesses.
- **Timesheet mode** — a date column, hours instead of quantity, and a total-hours line, for anyone billing time.
- **Service period** — the span of visits an invoice covers and how often you attend, for recurring cleaning, grounds maintenance and maintenance plans.
- **E-signature** — sign an invoice and email the signed PDF, with a signing record kept.
- **Crypto payment block** — USDT/USDC wallet address, network and a scannable QR code.

## Languages

Available in 15 languages with market-specific tax wording and currency:
English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Traditional Chinese,
Russian, Bengali, Korean, Japanese, Dutch, Swedish, Indonesian, Vietnamese.
Each language has one canonical home page at https://billcrafter.com/<code>.

## Notes

- BillCrafter is a document tool, not an accounting or legal service. Tax and contract rules vary by country and state, and the guides say so where it matters — in Brazil a PDF from here doesn't replace the nota fiscal, in Italy the SdI submission, in Korea a Hometax tax invoice, in Taiwan a 統一發票.
- Content use: search and AI-answer citation are welcome, model training is not. See https://billcrafter.com/robots.txt (`Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-input=yes,ai-train=no`).
